# Pinned existing iCetak source/readiness reader

These internal modules are a source snapshot of the production Task Workspace v23
bundle read on 6 November 2026. AI QC reuses its order-session boundaries, customer
sources, conflicts and readiness calculation. The original live Task Workspace is
not replaced by this bundle. Imports remain relative under this vendor directory.

Review upstream readiness changes before refreshing this snapshot. No credentials
or customer data belong here. Only the server-side service client supplies access.
